attributes.action: An immediate General Election to be held instead of an unelected new PM
attributes.additional_details:
For too long the people of Britain have been made to feel as second class citizens, this is our time to make the change needed to the UK , if the people of the united kingdom come together as one you show what the country needs and wants that being another General Election , we believe the people in power would not be in power due if an immediate election is called 
Stand up for your country and sign the petition
attributes.background: Yet Another Prime Minister is gone which leaves the country with another unelected prime minister as per the last Local Elections we saw a landslide victory for Reform , showing who the people want in power not another labour unelected MP/PM , I call on the people of Britain to back this petition

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
